results.name: Lankan Manna Cafe & Restaurant
results.description: A Sri Lankan cafe and restaurant in Mulgrave, working from recipes passed down through generations. The kitchen runs from morning through to breakfast, lunch and dinner, with rice and curry served with papadums and salads, kotthu roti, hoppers and string hoppers, devilled chicken and pork, and hot butter cuttlefish. A rotating Sri Lankan buffet runs on Saturday nights, and particular dishes appear on set days: biriyani mid-week, crab curry and roast paan on Fridays, lamprais and banana leaf rice packs on weekends. Vegan choices and a kids menu sit alongside the main list. Bookings are essential for the weekend buffet.

results.name: Malaysia Garden Restaurant
results.description: A Clayton Road restaurant serving Chinese cuisine alongside Malaysian dishes. The menu runs from Special Fried Rice — stir-fried with pork, shrimp, chicken, egg and bean shoots — to Char Kuey Teow with pipis and Chinese sausage, Combination Nasi Goreng, and Beef Rendang, beef chunks slow-cooked in coconut milk and spices. Roti and salt and pepper fried squid also appear. Open for lunch and dinner every day except Monday, with pickup available.

results.name: Tarragindi Thai Restaurant
results.description: A locally owned and run Thai restaurant at Shop 1/6 Gapap St, serving dishes made fresh daily for dine-in and takeaway. The menu runs to classic Thai favourites, from beef massaman curry to cashew nut stir fry, prepared with fresh ingredients.

results.name: Pho Oak Park
results.description: A Vietnamese restaurant on Snell Grove in Oak Park, serving pho and other Vietnamese dishes for dining in or taking away. The kitchen packages its meals for eating at home as well as at the tables. A straightforward neighbourhood spot run by its staff.

results.name: Q Barbeque
results.description:
Wood fire smoked American barbeque, cooked low and slow in large Texas-style offset smokers. The menu runs to 16-hour smoked wagyu brisket, beef ribs, pork ribs, pulled pork, Texas hot links, potacos, smash burgers and fried chicken, finished with house-made rubs and sauces, alongside sides like skin-on chips, onion rings and pickled slaw. Meat comes as individual plates or share platters such as the Texas Trinity.

Sundays bring a Bottomless BBQ at this Mulgrave venue, with 90 minutes of unlimited top-ups. A second Q Brewery & BBQ operates at Hallam, pouring Melbourne-made craft beer.
results.meritSplit: chain: Operates two locations (Mulgrave and Hallam), placing it in small-chain territory per our independence lens.

results.name: Our Table
results.description: A café and restaurant in Bedford serving food built around Italian, French and Spanish flavours, with chef Fabio Toscano heading the kitchen. The menu changes with the seasons, using produce sourced from local purveyors. A Gourmet Pantry attached to the eatery stocks treats to take home. Fully licensed, with BYO wine permitted for a corkage fee.
